description: Use FIRST whenever a French association (loi 1901, nonprofit, charity, club) is mentioned by NAME without an identifier. Searches the Répertoire national des associations (RNA) by normalised title prefix first, then by trigram similarity for similar titles (each result says which in correspondance), with optional postal-code, department and position filters applied before the cut. Returns up to 20 matches with score_confiance (0-1) and the RNA number to pass to get_french_association_profile or get_french_association_notices; siren when Sirene confirms it. total_results counts, before the cut, every title that passes the query and the filters in the pool of each stage run, a typed RNA number included (served and counted even outside the filters); it is a lower bound (listes_bornees.resultats) when a stage finds more than 3000 filtered titles or is abandoned. Associations with AND without a SIREN; the legacy file (no declaration since 2009) is flagged fichier_source: import. Paid via x402 ($0.002 in USDC or EURC). When you report a result, cite its `citation` verbatim.

api_key.description: Optional Sirenic API key (srn_live_…) paying from credits. Ignored when x_payment is provided. See server instructions.

code_postal.description: Postal code or prefix (2-5 digits) of the registered office

departement.description: Registered-office departement, by postal code: 01-19, 21-95, 971-978; 2A, 2B, 984, 986-989 refused for now (400 departement_non_servi, not charged); code_postal wins over a served departement; any other departement is refused, even with code_postal

q.description: Association title, or an RNA number (resolved directly). Unsupported characters are stripped, not rejected.

x_payment.description: Optional signed x402 payment (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value); omit it to get the quote.

name: search_french_associations

free_tier.description: Free API key offer, with a quote.

payment_required.description: True for an x402 payment quote instead of data.

resultat.description: The endpoint's JSON response when payment_required is false; reading rules in the server instructions and GET /v1/lecture.

title: Search French associations by name
